name: POS Floor, Table & Customer Info on Receipt
description: Enhance your Odoo Point of Sale (POS Restaurant) experience by displaying Floor, Table, and Customer details directly on printed receipts.

This module provides restaurant owners and staff with a more organized and transparent order management system. The Display Floor, Table, and Customer Details on POS Receipts module is a powerful and practical enhancement for Odoo Point of Sale (POS Restaurant) system. It provides a simple yet highly useful feature that allows restaurants, cafes, and hospitality businesses to print Floor Name, Table Number, and Customer Information directly on their POS receipts. This app bridges the gap between POS order management and real-world restaurant operations, ensuring that every printed receipt accurately reflects the order’s location (floor and table) and customer identity. With this added information, staff can serve more efficiently, managers can track orders precisely, and customers receive a more professional and personalized experience. name: POS Restrict Negative Stock
description: The POS Restrict Negative Stock module helps you maintain accurate inventory levels by preventing the sale of out-of-stock products directly from the Point of Sale (POS). When a cashier tries to add a product that exceeds available quantity, the system instantly blocks the action and displays a clear warning message
summary: The POS Restrict Negative Stock module is designed to help Odoo users maintain accurate inventory control and prevent negative stock issues directly within the Point of Sale (POS) environment. In standard Odoo, POS sessions can continue processing sales even when product quantities fall below zero which can cause serious inconsistencies between your sales and inventory data. This module solves that problem by introducing real-time stock validation during POS operations. The configuration process is simple and intuitive just activate the “Restrict Product Out of Stock” option in the POS settings. The feature instantly becomes active for that specific POS configuration, working seamlessly in the background without requiring additional customization or manual setup. It integrates natively with Odoo Inventory and POS modules, meaning all stock levels are validated in real-time based on actual warehouse quantities. the module continuously checks product availability as cashiers add items to the POS cart. Whenever a product’s requested quantity exceeds the available stock, the system automatically blocks the transaction and displays a clear, informative popup message. The alert indicates the product name, available stock quantity, the number of items already in the cart, and the attempted additional quantity. This ensures that your staff cannot oversell items or process orders that would push stock levels into the negative.
